title: Expected evidence classes for adep.profile.pa.basic.v0
description: Normative annex to ADEP-WI5-PA-v0. W3-T05, 2026-10-25. AI draft for review. The dialect is JSON Schema draft 2020-12, the same dialect as the completeness fragments. The array is the instance list for this profile. It may be empty, and it is not required to contain every class. PA-EC-20 through PA-EC-24 are defined and are not required in M2 test coverage. This fragment does not define PA-EC-16 through PA-EC-19.
